comparison.objective: Connect four sprung booster clamps to batteries and an engine ground in a safe sequence.
comparison.physical_skill: Opening spring clamps, seating jaws on tapered posts, deformable-cable management, and ordered bimanual connection.
comparison.success_condition: Each clamp remains spring-held on the correct target in order; hazardous polarity, order, or jaw-contact errors force zero.
comparison.reason: This tests clamp actuation, cable management, and procedural electrical safety. It does not test impact fracture, mandrel stabilization, coil retention, or fragment containment.
